S0609b.or: Deus, qui beátam Diánam Vírginem tuam admirábili spíritus fortitúdine donásti; eíque in terénda evangélicæ perfectiónis via beátas Cæcíliam et Amátam cómites dedísti: concéde propítius, ut eárum exémplo roborémur in árduis; et in advérsis protegámur auxílio: Per Dóminum.
S0609b.se: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut quod tibi in honórem beátæ Vírginis Diánæ ac sociárum ejus Cæcíliæ et Amátæ offérimus sacrifícium, ipsis intercedéntibus, ad salútem nobis proveníre concédas. Per Dóminum.
S0609b.pc: Percépta sacraménta, clementíssime Jesu, áugeant in nobis tuæ dilectiónis afféctum: ut cum beátis Virgínibus Diána, Cæcília et Amáta despiciéntes terréna; ad tuum cæléste consórtium júgiter aspirémus: Qui vivis et regnas.

en.or: O God, who endowed blessed Diana, Your virgin, with wonderful strength of spirit, and gave her blessed Cecilia and Amata as companions in treading the way of evangelical perfection; mercifully grant that by their example we may be strengthened in hardships and protected by their help in adversity
en.se: We beseech You, almighty God, that the sacrifice which we offer You in honor of blessed Diana, virgin, and of her companions Cecilia and Amata, may by their intercession avail for our salvation
en.pc: May the sacraments we have received, most merciful Jesus, increase in us the affection of Your love; that with the blessed virgins Diana, Cecilia and Amata, despising earthly things, we may ever long for Your heavenly fellowship
